selected_defect: V05 named MESH_PCB_01 but its compact horizontal placement did not communicate a clear installation location or serviceable I/O relationship.
source_repair: Move MESH_PCB_01 to a front-facing vertical mount in the A-zone dry controller bay.
Add an insulated mounting plate, guard frame, four standoffs, controller components and PWR/CH4/CO/O2/FAN terminal blocks.
Route named low-voltage cable curves from the terminal row into the existing front cable duct.
limitation: The cable colors and PCB labels are demonstrator-level visual identifiers; final physical wiring must follow the selected low-voltage controller and terminal specifications.
